title: Round 3 review of PR #3224 found three leftovers around closed page items and the grant check (L1 to L3)
why:
Lane of PR #3224 (session_013NEJKyqQmpj2FNxeZzDV7s), at the coordinator's 14:02 CST word, 14:00 CST Nov 13: round 3 review of head 846c523f27 (page_grant rule 4, ruling own-748-b-rule-4). COMBINE FINDING 15:16 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:14, relaying lane g1 and the round 1 reviewer of #3418, PASS, record comment 6884294991; triage read none): #3224 (rule 4, routed_close) and #3308 (a Relayed Grant entry) together allow a grant on a closed item when lane, home and lastAnswer.at match, which main refuses. Mistake path: the owning session counts its own kept routed answer before the receiver reports done (docs/decisions/relayed-grant-read-from-page.md around line 60); harm: the named act runs a second time. Rulings found by triage: own-748-b-rule-4 and own-753-a-relayed-grant-entry already let a routed closed item count; neither names the owning session's own count. Put to the owner as page item 842 (pick-3418-closed-grant-members): a leave both out of #3418 (the coordinator's recommendation), b keep both in (widens), c change both to refuse and rebuild. Lane g1 holds the lane lint and hands nothing in until he answers. ITEM 842 REVISED 15:17 CST Nov 14 (coordinator 15:17, its own miss: it wrote the question without searching the owner's rulings): #3224 and #3308 are the implementation of own-748-b-rule-4 and own-753-a-relayed-grant-entry, so the receiver's routed case is not at stake; only the narrow path the reviewer named is: the owning session counts its own kept routed answer before the receiver reports done (relayed-grant-read-from-page.md around line 60; harm: the named act runs twice). Revised options: (a) leave both out of #3418 now and fix each in its own lane (receiver's routed case counts; the owner's own count before done is refused), then merge each alone (starred at the coordinator's recommendation); (b) keep both in as they are (widens); (c) hold the whole combine until both are fixed. The old option c is withdrawn. Item 842 is rewritten in place on the page. OWNER ANSWER 16:32 CST Nov 14 (page item 842, ruling own-842-a-leave-out-fix-alone): option a, no note. Leave #3224 and #3308 out of #3418 now and fix each in its own lane (receiver's routed case counts; the owning session's own count before done is refused), then merge each alone. Item 842 is closed. Lanes: fix-3224-own-count-closed and fix-3308-own-count-closed (todo, coordinator starts them). Triage did not read which of L1 to L3 belongs to which PR: unknown; the lanes say.

[00:16 CST Nov 16, triage] Full note before the trim to 200 words (goal item 6, option b):
Todo. Facts as the lane read them on the origin/roadmap waiting/ mirror; the live page was not read. L1 (debt candidate): old closes left `lane` on the item, so 44 closed items hold lane + lastAnswer + a kept answer; 30 of them now pass rule 4 (main refused them as closed); all 44 go unnamed by the kept-answer line (stale_pages.py 576-577). Examples: cs-1421-press-merge, auto-mode-allow-lines, guard-fix-check-sonnet. Fix idea: a one-time sweep that deletes the done acts' answers or drops their `lane`. L2 (note): an exact string compare of `at` (page_grant.py 270-276) false-refuses 14 of the 44, whose lastAnswer.at is cut to seconds; fails closed, the owner then types the grant in chat. L3 (note): an older open item with `lane` stays open and unanswered on the done path (SKILL.md "Never-ending wait" and Dead receiver bullet); two such items: drain-2071-guard-incident, qmax-d369-error-source. Nothing on #3224 changes. Triage adds: on Nov 13 triage wrote 139 receipts for closed items and left their answers in the answers collection (step answers-ledger-followups), which adds to the kept-answer count for L1. L1 is a debt only if Claude is likely to hit it in normal work: unjudged. Past rulings not checked. Owner 14:24 CST: item 753 a, edit the Relayed Merge Yes entry and pinned test to match 748 b (ruling own-753-a-relayed-grant-entry); the lane of PR #3224 builds it (via the coordinator). Answered 18:29 CST Nov 13: owner 753 a, ruling own-753-a-relayed-grant-entry (rewritten in place with the re-pick time). Lane (session_013NEJKyqQmpj2FNxeZzDV7s) 18:54 CST Nov 13: PR #3308 (the Relayed Grant clause, ruling own-753-a-relayed-grant-entry) handed to runner 10, head 5fde4b2b66; it merges after #3224. NOTE for the notes file (the lane's reading, unchecked by triage; low harm because page_grant still gates): the pin RELAYED_CLOSED in hooks/test_auto_mode_allow.py (~lines 132-135) does not hold "non-blank" or "arbiter not true", so a clause without them still passes. Suggested pin: add tokens `non-blank` and `arbiter.*not true`. It becomes a debt only after a real incident.
